fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+html, articleBody pulled from HTML article.single-article div.post-content since the Yoast ld+json @graph has no articleBody) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-rss, punchng.com/feed) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld+html, S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (not_found, not_article, http_<code>, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the Yoast ld+json NewsArticle node.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description, from <meta name="description"> (falls back to the ld+json WebPage node's description).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, joined from direct-child

tags of article.single-article div.post-content (excludes ad slots, share widgets, and related-article teaser cards, which sit outside that scope).

author.title: Author
author.description: Comma-joined byline name(s), from the ld+json NewsArticle author field (inline on this site, not a bare @id reference).

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher/site name ("Punch Newspapers"), read from <meta property="og:site_name"> -- there is no Organization node in this site's ld+json graph.

articleSection.title: Article section
articleSection.description: Section/category tags from the ld+json NewsArticle node (e.g. ["Business & Economy"]).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keyword tags from the ld+json NewsArticle node.

thumbnailUrl.title: Thumbnail URL
thumbnailUrl.description: Lead image URL from the ld+json NewsArticle node's thumbnailUrl field.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode RSS item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the RSS item (carries rss.punchng.com utm tracking params, passed through raw).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: List of <category> values from the RSS item -- observed always empty on this feed.

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: RSS item guid (same URL as link).

enclosureUrl.title: Enclosure URL
enclosureUrl.description: Image URL from the RSS item's <enclosure> tag -- observed to be the generic Punch masthead logo on every item, not a per-article thumbnail. Use article mode's thumbnailUrl for a real lead image.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
